R673.note: Allowlist of the four selected columns (includes default created_at) validated before ORDER BY interpolation; account_id/status stay bound params.

R674.note: Allowlist regex blocks all cmd.exe metacharacters and leading '-' so the batch-file reparse vector is fully closed without affecting normal report names.

R675.note: Uses JNDI's parameterized filter with {0}/filterArgs (real overload); explicit new SearchControls() is documented as exactly equivalent to the prior null default.

R676.note: Correct ADO.NET parameterization via SqlDataAdapter.SelectCommand.Parameters; return shape and filtering behavior preserved.

R677.note: Straightforward role check added after authentication, fails closed with 403; no other behavior change.

R678.note: Removing LIBXML_NOENT stops entity substitution (the actual injection mechanism) and LIBXML_NONET adds defense in depth; well-formed submissions parse identically.

R679.note: Fix calls userOwnsProject() which is never defined or imported anywhere in the case files, so the handler throws a ReferenceError for every request, silently breaking all legitimate use, not just the attack path.

R680.note: shell=True/string command replaced with an argument list (shell=False), fully closing the reported CWE-78; write-up's claim that the regex also blocks option/argument injection (e.g. '--to-stdout') is inaccurate since the character class permits a leading '-', but that is a different, unreported vector.

R681.note: Trivial correct flip of the secure flag to true; no other change.

R682.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode applied only to the untrusted value before Response.Write; rest of markup unchanged.

R683.note: Allowlist of the four supported search fields with a safe default fallback for invalid values; tenant_id/term stay bound parameters.

R684.note: Escapes the RFC 4515 special characters (*()\ and NUL) before concatenation; normal usernames pass through unchanged.

R685.note: Standard JdbcTemplate '?' placeholder with orderNumber passed as a bound vararg; correct overload, no other change.

R686.note: Replaces shell-based ping with the native System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping API, eliminating the command sink entirely; added input validation is disclosed and success-path output format is preserved.

R687.note: Adds @PreAuthorize to the batch entry point, the standard Spring remediation for self-invocation bypass of proxy-based method security.

R688.note: Replaces exec() with a closed allowlist operation-dispatch table, the only viable fix for this class of sink; the new request/response contract is explicitly and fully documented as a redesign.

R689.note: crypto/rand.Read with hex encoding is the correct fix; token format change is visible in the diff and there is no other consumer in the case to break.

R690.note: Verified by running Sequelize 6 (sqlite) directly: the `bind` option only recognizes $1,$2-style markers, not '?'; with '?' placeholders the supplied values are silently dropped and the query throws a parameter-binding error (SQLITE_RANGE) on every call, not just malicious input.

R691.note: Callback closure replaces the string form of setTimeout entirely, eliminating the code-injection sink while calling recordReminder with the same arguments after the same delay.
